; xovi-zotero-bridge "Send to Zotero" reader toolbar button and upload dialog,
; for the reMarkable 3.28 resource layout. Requires qt-resource-rebuilder,
; qt-command-executor, and the bridge installed at /home/root/xovi-zotero-bridge.
; Structural TRAVERSE/LOCATE targets and native-component property tokens below
; are copied verbatim from the community-published, firmware-matched
; touchLock.qmd (rmitchellscott/xovi-qmd-extensions) so this patch reuses only
; confirmed-safe hash tokens for this firmware. Do not install on another
; firmware layout. UNTESTED on-device; validate carefully before relying on it.
; Ships its own glyph icon (xovi/assets/zotero-send-icon.png) instead of
; guessing an unverified native icon-resource hash.

; Add zoteroDialogVisible property and the reader toolbar button.
; AFFECT id reused from touchLock.qmd/penLayerMemory.qmd: it identifies the
; reader-root target type, not this file, and must match the firmware's
; hashtab rather than being invented.
AFFECT [[11313888899523275277]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property ~&6503679477&~ zoteroDialogVisible: ~&214625660372&~
        }

        TRAVERSE [[6502786168]]#[[233745975898428]] > [[8398044571386570029]]
            LOCATE BEFORE [[7712155293725601]][.[[8399878573055752961]]=[["3575461827597527778]]]
            INSERT {
                ~&454089850271038938&~ {
                    ~&5972374&~: zoteroSendButton
                    ~&233745975898428&~: ~&6504254477&~
                    ~&6504337259&~: ~&454089850271038938&~.~&6503187275&~.~&14888501028015932088&~

                    property ~&6503679477&~ _isExtensionButton: ~&6504329801&~
                    ~&8399601734642709923&~: "file:///home/root/xovi-zotero-bridge/assets/zotero-send-icon.png"
                    ~&233726547792244&~: !!~&7712934851008712&~ && ~&6504254477&~.~&4367731859579753176&~ > 7
                    ~&233748328658231&~: !!~&7712934851008712&~ && ~&6504254477&~.~&4367731859579753176&~ > 7

                    ~&254542253295368380&~: {
                        ~&6504254477&~.zoteroDialogVisible = ~&6504329801&~;
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Settings menu entry when the toolbar is cramped (portrait).

; Settings-menu target.
AFFECT [[11704595946725378272]]
    TRAVERSE [[454089850271038938]]#[[6504254477]] > [[254480451320573660]]#[[16710723433319324941]] > [[14125623155555875541]]#[[233724020048228]]
        LOCATE AFTER [[425121728314878811.15740235808997988493]]
        INSERT {
            ~&425121728314878811&~.~&432643201877711221&~ {
                ~&214632764553&~: ~&6504222003&~("Send to Zotero")
                ~&233748328658231&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&4367731859579753176&~ <= 7 &&
                         ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&14953652214069020552&~.~&14593461789319363686&~
                ~&254542236275632405&~: {
                    ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.zoteroDialogVisible = ~&6504329801&~;

    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; More Tools menu entry when the toolbar is cramped (landscape).
; AFFECT id reused from touchLock.qmd/penLayerMemory.qmd for this same
; More-Tools-menu target.
AFFECT [[6025599999262907645]]
    TRAVERSE [[454089850271038938]]#[[6504254477]]
        TRAVERSE [[14125623155555875541]]
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                ~&425121728314878811&~.~&432643201877711221&~ {
                    ~&214632764553&~: ~&6504222003&~("Send to Zotero")
                    ~&233748328658231&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&4367731859579753176&~ <= 7 &&
                             !~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&14953652214069020552&~.~&14593461789319363686&~
                    ~&254542236275632405&~: {
                        ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.zoteroDialogVisible = ~&6504329801&~;

; Upload dialog overlay. Inserted at the same overlay anchor touchLock.qmd
; uses for its full-screen touch-blocking rectangle. Everything below this
; point is freshly authored QML (not a native compiled component), so it uses
; plain property/type names rather than firmware-specific hash tokens.
; AFFECT id reused from touchLock.qmd/penLayerMemory.qmd for this same
; reader-root overlay-parent target.
AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor [[180922.180921]]

    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]] > [[6502786168]]#[[15549782143769420265]]
        LOCATE BEFORE [[233704648923420]]
        INSERT {
            Rectangle {
                id: zoteroSendDialog
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 9999
                color: "white"
                visible: ~&6504254477&~.zoteroDialogVisible

                property string docUuid: ""
                property string statusText: "Send this document to Zotero."
                property var tagsList: []
                property var tagSelection: ({})
                property string mode: "new"
                property bool mapped: false
                property string mappedTitle: ""
                property string parentKey: ""
                property var searchResults: []
                property bool busy: false

                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

                onVisibleChanged: {
                    if (visible) {
                        docUuid = !!~&7712934851008712&~ ? ~&7712934851008712&~.~&5972374&~ : "";
                        mode = "new"; parentKey = ""; searchResults = []; tagSelection = ({});
                        tagsList = []; mapped = false; mappedTitle = "";
                        if (docUuid.length > 0) runStatus();
                        else statusText = "No document is open.";
                    }
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: zoteroDialogCommand
                    command: "sh"
                    property string output: ""
                    property string errorOutput: ""
                    property string pending: ""
                    onStdOutAvailable: function(chunk) { output += chunk; }
                    onStdErrAvailable: function(chunk) { errorOutput += chunk; }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (!running && zoteroSendDialog.busy) zoteroSendDialog.finishCommand();
                    }
                }

                function run(kind, arguments) {
                    if (busy) return;
                    busy = true;
                    zoteroDialogCommand.pending = kind;
                    zoteroDialogCommand.output = "";
                    zoteroDialogCommand.errorOutput = "";
                    zoteroDialogCommand.arguments = [
                        "/home/root/xovi-zotero-bridge/scripts/zotbridge-run.sh"
                    ].concat(arguments);
                    if (!zoteroDialogCommand.startCommand(30000)) {
                        busy = false;
                        statusText = "Could not start bridge command.";
                    }
                }

                function runStatus() {
                    statusText = "Checking Zotero status\u2026";
                    run("status", ["doc-status", "--uuid", docUuid]);
                }

                function runTags() {
                    run("tags", ["doc-tags", "--uuid", docUuid]);
                }

                function runSearch(query) {
                    if (query.length === 0) return;
                    statusText = "Searching Zotero\u2026";
                    run("search", ["list", "--query", query, "--json", "--limit", "10"]);
                }

                function submit() {
                    if (mode === "attach" && parentKey.length !== 8) {
                        statusText = "Choose a parent item to attach to.";
                        return;
                    }
                    var chosenTags = [];
                    for (var key in tagSelection) if (tagSelection[key]) chosenTags.push(key);
                    var arguments = ["push-document", "--uuid", docUuid, "--mode", mode];
                    if (mode === "attach") arguments = arguments.concat(["--parent-key", parentKey]);
                    if (chosenTags.length > 0) arguments = arguments.concat(["--tags", chosenTags.join(",")]);
                    statusText = "Sending to Zotero\u2026";
                    run("push", arguments);
                }

                function finishCommand() {
                    busy = false;
                    var result;
                    try { result = JSON.parse(zoteroDialogCommand.output); }
                    catch (error) {
                        statusText = "Bridge returned an invalid response.";
                        return;
                    }
                    if (zoteroDialogCommand.exitCode !== 0 || result.ok !== true) {
                        statusText = "Bridge error: " + (result.error || ("exit " + zoteroDialogCommand.exitCode));
                        return;
                    }
                    var kind = zoteroDialogCommand.pending;
                    if (kind === "status") {
                        mapped = !!result.mapped;
                        mappedTitle = result.zotero_item_title || "";
                        mode = mapped ? "overwrite" : "new";
                        runTags();
                    } else if (kind === "tags") {
                        tagsList = result.tags || [];
                        var selection = ({});
                        for (var i = 0; i < tagsList.length; i++) selection[tagsList[i]] = true;
                        tagSelection = selection;
                        statusText = mapped ?
                            ("Already linked to \"" + mappedTitle + "\".") :
                            "Not yet linked to Zotero. Choose how to send it.";
                    } else if (kind === "search") {
                        searchResults = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];
                        statusText = searchResults.length + " matching Zotero items.";
                    } else if (kind === "push") {
                        statusText = "Sent to Zotero.";
                    }
                }

                Flickable {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    anchors.margins: 40
                    contentWidth: width
                    contentHeight: form.height
                    clip: true
                    Column {
                        id: form
                        width: parent.width
                        spacing: 16

                        Text { text: "Send to Zotero"; font.pixelSize: 34; font.bold: true }
                        Text {
                            text: zoteroSendDialog.statusText
                            font.pixelSize: 20; wrapMode: Text.WordWrap; width: parent.width
                        }

                        Row {
                            spacing: 12
                            visible: zoteroSendDialog.mapped
                            Repeater {
                                model: ["overwrite", "attach"]
                                delegate: Rectangle {
                                    width: 240; height: 56
                                    color: zoteroSendDialog.mode === modelData ? "black" : "white"
                                    border.width: 2; border.color: "black"
                                    Text {
                                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                                        text: modelData === "overwrite" ? "Overwrite linked PDF" : "Attach new version"
                                        color: zoteroSendDialog.mode === modelData ? "white" : "black"
                                        font.pixelSize: 20
                                    }
                                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: zoteroSendDialog.mode = modelData }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Row {
                            spacing: 12
                            visible: !zoteroSendDialog.mapped
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 220; height: 56
                                color: zoteroSendDialog.mode === "new" ? "black" : "white"
                                border.width: 2; border.color: "black"
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Create new item"
                                    color: zoteroSendDialog.mode === "new" ? "white" : "black"; font.pixelSize: 20
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: zoteroSendDialog.mode = "new" }
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 240; height: 56
                                color: zoteroSendDialog.mode === "attach" ? "black" : "white"
                                border.width: 2; border.color: "black"
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Attach to existing item"
                                    color: zoteroSendDialog.mode === "attach" ? "white" : "black"; font.pixelSize: 20
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: zoteroSendDialog.mode = "attach" }
                            }
                        }

                        Text { text: "Search parent item"; font.pixelSize: 22; visible: zoteroSendDialog.mode === "attach" }
                        TextInput {
                            id: zoteroParentSearch
                            visible: zoteroSendDialog.mode === "attach"
                            width: parent.width; font.pixelSize: 24; selectByMouse: true
                            Keys.onReturnPressed: { zoteroSendDialog.runSearch(text); focus = false; Qt.inputMethod.hide(); }
                            Keys.onEnterPressed: { zoteroSendDialog.runSearch(text); focus = false; Qt.inputMethod.hide(); }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            visible: zoteroSendDialog.mode === "attach"
                            width: parent.width; height: 220
                            color: "white"; border.width: 2; border.color: "black"
                            Flickable {
                                anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: 8; clip: true
                                contentWidth: width; contentHeight: parentResults.height
                                Column {
                                    id: parentResults; width: parent.width
                                    Repeater {
                                        model: zoteroSendDialog.searchResults
                                        delegate: Rectangle {
                                            width: parentResults.width; height: 54
                                            color: zoteroSendDialog.parentKey === modelData.item_key ? "#dddddd" : "white"
                                            Text {
                                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter; x: 10
                                                width: parent.width - 20; elide: Text.ElideRight
                                                text: modelData.title; font.pixelSize: 20
                                            }
                                            MouseArea {
                                                anchors.fill: parent
                                                onClicked: zoteroSendDialog.parentKey = modelData.item_key
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Text { text: "Tags"; font.pixelSize: 22 }
                        Rectangle {
                            width: parent.width; height: 160
                            color: "white"; border.width: 2; border.color: "black"
                            Flickable {
                                anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: 8; clip: true
                                contentWidth: width; contentHeight: tagList.height
                                Column {
                                    id: tagList; width: parent.width
                                    Repeater {
                                        model: zoteroSendDialog.tagsList
                                        delegate: Rectangle {
                                            width: tagList.width; height: 48; color: "white"
                                            Row {
                                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter; x: 10; spacing: 10
                                                Rectangle {
                                                    width: 28; height: 28; border.width: 2; border.color: "black"
                                                    color: zoteroSendDialog.tagSelection[modelData] ? "black" : "white"
                                                }
                                                Text { text: modelData; font.pixelSize: 20 }
                                            }
                                            MouseArea {
                                                anchors.fill: parent
                                                onClicked: {
                                                    var selection = zoteroSendDialog.tagSelection;
                                                    selection[modelData] = !selection[modelData];
                                                    zoteroSendDialog.tagSelection = Object.assign({}, selection);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Row {
                            spacing: 20
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 220; height: 64
                                color: zoteroSendDialog.busy ? "#aaaaaa" : "black"
                                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Send"; color: "white"; font.pixelSize: 24 }
                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    enabled: !zoteroSendDialog.busy
                                    onClicked: zoteroSendDialog.submit()
                                }
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 160; height: 64
                                color: "white"; border.width: 2; border.color: "black"
                                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Close"; font.pixelSize: 24 }
                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    onClicked: ~&6504254477&~.zoteroDialogVisible = ~&214625660372&~
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
